name: searchInsert
fn: function searchInsert(nums, target) {   let left = 0, right = nums.length - 1;   while (left <= right) {     const mid = Math.floor(left + (right - left) / 2);     if (nums[mid] === target)       return mid;     if (nums[mid] < target)       left = mid + 1;     else       right = mid - 1;   }   return left; }
